title: Two minutes when a 12.7% bonus was not enough

numbers.what: The two minutes of the event
numbers.source: Block timestamps on Base: the oracle step at 21:56:03 UTC and the liquidations that waited more than 20 blocks, 21:56:07 to 21:57:39 UTC

numbers.what: cbXRP on Base exchanges below XRP on Coinbase, in the minutes 21:56 and 21:57 UTC
numbers.source: Swaps in the cbXRP pools on Base, volume-weighted within the minute ($224,001 and $59,227 of swaps), against the Coinbase XRP-USD minute candle, (high + low + close) / 3; the minutes 21:56 and 21:57 UTC

numbers.what: Positions that stayed liquidatable before somebody took them, and for how long
numbers.source: Morpho Blue liquidation events on Base outside auctions in the cbXRP/USDC 62.5% market; the position at the end of the block before its liquidation and the market's oracle price block by block, read from an archive node; the wait is counted from the first block from whose end the position was liquidatable; more than 20 blocks

numbers.what: The market
numbers.source: data/exit-depth.json of the snapshot 2026-11-17T06:23Z (data sha256 8c30bf86, commit 5d65c89): lltv 0.625

numbers.what: Block time on Base that day, and the longest wait in blocks
numbers.source: Base block headers on 8 November 2026: blocks 54744122 to 54745122, 200 s for 1,000 blocks; the longest wait, 401 blocks (80.2 s)

numbers.what: Liquidation bonus of cbXRP/USDC at LLTV 62.5%
numbers.source: data/exit-depth.json of the snapshot 2026-11-17T06:23Z (data sha256 8c30bf86, commit 5d65c89): bonus 0.12676

numbers.what: The highest bonus among the markets of the snapshot
numbers.source: data/exit-depth.json of the snapshot 2026-11-17T06:23Z (data sha256 8c30bf86, commit 5d65c89): the largest bonus of its 47 markets, 0.12676, in all 10 markets with LLTV 62.5% and in no other

numbers.what: The previous time cbXRP traded below Coinbase on Base
numbers.source: Morpho Blue liquidation events on Base outside auctions in the cbXRP/USDC 62.5% market, 24 hours from 20:00 UTC on 29 October: all 259 taken in the block from which they were liquidatable (227) or in the next (32); pool swaps against the Coinbase candle in the minutes with a discount of 2% or more: -3.54%, -3.58%, -3.99% (00:22, 00:27, 00:30 UTC on 30 October)

numbers.what: Block time on Base on 30 October
numbers.source: Base block headers on 30 October 2026: blocks 53286127 to 53287127, 2,000 s for 1,000 blocks

numbers.what: Share of the bonus that went through auctions attached to oracle updates
numbers.source: data/liquidations.json of the snapshot 2026-11-17T06:23Z (data sha256 8c30bf86, commit 5d65c89): 6,799,061 of 7,285,887 USD of bonus went through auctions, 18 October to 17 November

numbers.what: Break-even exit cost at this bonus
numbers.source: Arithmetic: 1 - 1/(1 + bonus) = 1 - 100 / 112.676 = 0.1125 (website/exposure.py breakeven, Method page)

numbers.what: How much the site's clearance before Clearance v3 (bonus minus exit cost) overstated the room at this bonus
numbers.source: Arithmetic: 12.68 - 11.25 = 1.43; Clearance v3 of 16 Nov 2026 (Method changelog; Corrections on the About page: 0.01 to 1.43 points, the most at LLTV 62.5%)

numbers.what: A small bonus, for comparison
numbers.source: data/exit-depth.json of the snapshot 2026-11-17T06:23Z (data sha256 8c30bf86, commit 5d65c89): bonus 0.02617 in the 14 markets with LLTV 91.5%

numbers.what: cbXRP redeems one for one at Coinbase
text: one cbXRP redeems for one XRP
numbers.source: CoinDesk's cbXRP page, https://www.coindesk.com/price/coinbase-wrapped-xrp (read 17 Nov 2026): cbXRP represents XRP held 1:1 in Coinbase custody, and holders redeem the XRP by depositing cbXRP back into their Coinbase accounts
